name: app-black-lime-cgm-health-tracker-flow-with-captions
title: Black and Lime Glucose Tracker Flow
whatItIs: A black page with phones stepping down: a camera scan screen with a sensor ring, a lime reminder card with an hours stepper, and a cream home with tilted lime and dark cards, joined to tiny captions and a large light title 'Veri Device Healthcare Tracker'.
whatItMeans: Neon lime on black feels clinical yet energetic, and tilted cards add life to numbers.
techniques: Lime as the only accent on black
Tilted overlapping cards on the home screen
Camera scan overlay with ring and distance label
Big light title in the corner

vocabulary.definition: A ring and instruction layered over a camera view.
A control with minus and plus to change a number.
Cards rotated and overlapped for energy.
